newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank says conditions good for inflation goal.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank says conditions good for inflation goal.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Thursday lowered its interest rate corridor by 50 basis points saying conditions were still good for inflation to be in line with the inflation target.
"The conditions for inflation in line with the inflation target are still considered to be good," the Riksbank said in a statement.
"The continued analysis of the outlook for inflation will be crucial for the construction of monetary policy."
The Riksbank said the cut, taking the deposit rate down to 3.75 percent and the lending rate to 5.25 percent, would take effect from December 11.
The central rate in its three tier system, the repo rate, currently stands at 4.35 percent.
The Riksbank will release its latest inflation report on December 17, the same day it sets a reverse repurchase operation for three weeks to cover the holiday period.
The Swedish government has set an inflation target of two percent with flexibility of one percentage point either way.
